analysis.evidence: In אָסָא אַולֵדֿ ליָהֻושָפָֿט, Asa is the subject and the prefixed ל marks Jehoshaphat as the object. The clause identifies Asa as Jehoshaphat’s father.
analysis.morphology: Aphel perfect, third person masculine singular

analysis.evidence: In אָסָא אַולֵדֿ ליָהֻושָפָֿט, Asa fathers Jehoshaphat. The next clause repeats the name without ל as its subject, יָהֻושָפָֿט אַולֵדֿ ליֻורָמ (“Jehoshaphat fathered Joram”).
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular personal name with prefixed ל marking the direct object of אַולֵדֿ (“fathered”).
analysis.sense: Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, son of Asa and father of Joram.
